protocol.question: Does the E97 planned independent-family data expansion improve the fixed joint relic/card readout under the now repaired E98 engine?

small.selection: E87 fit family IDs, with all outcomes regenerated under E98.

expanded.selection: The same1536 plus all3072 E97 additional fit family IDs; no success selection.

protocol.representation: Inherited frozen parent192-dimensional public-state/candidate embeddings; two learned linear readouts plus fit-only option biases. Centered features and RMS scales fitted only on each arms own fit families, parent score bias1, unknown whole offers use parent. No seed or future state features.
protocol.objective: Inherited exact expected terminal binary Heart outcome over all assigned fit families and complete two-decision trees plus fixedL2; no invented preference for equal outcomes, no success-only imitation, no layer reward.
protocol.selection: Train both final checkpoints before common heldout scoring, fixed1000 steps and L2.001, no CV, checkpoint or hyperparameter sweep. Each arm vs parent must net>=20 wins and paired exactp<.05 across common1024. Claim a data-scale gain only if expanded vs small independently meets net>=20 and pairedp<.05. The pairwise development screens are not independent acceptance.
protocol.downstream: Verify both live choice sets on all reachable heldout families. Qualifying arms then require natural512-development net>=10 and pairedp<.05, zero faults, full terminal/RNG/NN audits, correct scoped first change, winner replans and original winning-route verification. Choose more wins, fewer lost parent wins, then small on a tie. No candidate adoption or natural evaluation by the training command itself.
protocol.implementation_change: One canonical E100 repaired-engine label store. Nested subsets replace E97s planned join of old and new stores because historicalE86 labels are invalid after repair; the fit recipe, common roles and decision scope remain fixed.
protocol.dependency: All E99 source and original-development gates and E100 complete label audits. No output model directory may be created before these pass.
protocol.limits: A test of the unexecuted data-scale hypothesis on narrow coupled decisions. It is not a full-policy ceiling or the50percent goal. Failed E89/E95/E96 results stay recorded. Final acceptance requires a separately frozen candidate and1024 truly unseen families.

data_entry.limits: Historical E89 data is used only for loader-format/partition controls. Actual E100 labels and model fitting remain gated.

native_choice_probe.limits: Observed E98 parent branch only, using two software-only zero-head models; not a complete counterfactual tree or E101 learning result.

source_changes.changed_training_scope: Constants and assigned_roles/load_inputs/train input wiring use one E100 corrected label table with registered nested family groups. The fit loop/optimizer/heldout gates are inherited.
source_changes.changed_verification_scope: verify loads that same single corrected table and selects small_fit from registered groups; native learning_worker is byte-identical.
